text: Payment retries must strictly not exceed 3 attempts per case. Retries for bank_decline and gateway_timeout should be delayed by at least 30 minutes. If 3 retries fail, auto-escalate to human.
Customer contact messages (SMS, email, WhatsApp) require a 24-hour cooldown between messages. Any customer with opt_out set to true must never be contacted automatically under any circumstance.
High value B2B overdue invoices (> ₹50,000) with broken promises to pay or failed second reminders must be escalated directly to Tier 2 Account Managers.
Checkout recovery links expire after 48 hours. Optional recovery incentives (e.g. 5% discount) are allowed for cart abandonment with amount > ₹2,000.
